pr.title: T-3088: Occupied transport loops and walk-up controls
pr.body:
Otis Bardwell drives an occupied wagon circuit in 1835, and Hans Johnson drives a Brougham circuit in 1904, in Full or Balanced detail. Walk up and use the shared Interact control to Stop or Continue; Step back checks visitor clearance. Driver picks and Find use the named person and the vehicle’s current position. Light retires the occupied assembly.

Inspector retains the requested person through its first mount/shown redraw, while Back clears the pending selection. The portable drivers, horses, fitted hitch and reconstructed routes retain their provenance.

Memory changes preserve scenery and quality settings: avoid importing unsupported town scenes, use exact count-only flora/timber storage, reconstruct static railway CPU data exactly on demand, and release uploaded static street-tree geometry through the existing policy. Memory ceilings are unchanged.

Validation on checked commit `ae762df51dad3bd48e7d5307e0bda3cd0ce05e31`:

- All four native parts passed: 1,150 checks including 400 self-tests, each within its original 600-second limit.
- Five actual-commit changelog/history/identifier checks and whitespace passed.
- Original Chromium 141 mobile memory check passed on the exact tested source: 1904 **399.962 MiB / 400**. The final commit and any later DEV integration still need their own CI results.
- Static street-tree lifecycle controls preserve geometry, bounds, LOD/fade, disposal and retained dynamic data. Existing railway replay and paired timber/flora controls remain intact.

This is an incremental driving and interaction delivery. Broader photographic appearance, gait, boarding, riding and natural seated animation remain open. Motion uses Full or Balanced; this PR does not claim completion of those broader tickets. Current-source CI must pass before the ordinary DEV merge.

### Active recovery checkpoint — 3 November 2026

The public PR HEAD is still `ae762df`; the new integration has not been committed or merged yet. The final candidate is frozen at TREE `ef566b99` with DEV `92bee8bd` included. The native full preflight is running: **part 1 passed 290 checks, including 103 self-tests; part 2 is active** (1,152 distinct checks and 400 self-tests across all four parts). The merged liberties and source-use reports pass their canonical owners, and the stale Mayer input has been rebuilt through its native generator.

The memory repairs passed actual published Chromium 141 phone checks on the immediately preceding TREE `5ede905`: **1904 399.0/400 MiB; 1812 222.5/225 MiB**. The subsequent DEV change adds 23,304 decoded geometry bytes and preserves all 16 embedded images; these old memory passes are not relabelled as a reading of the newer candidate. Fresh CI on the checked push will test the final source. Full Git history remains enabled; the gate/lap checkout adds only `filter: blob:none` to avoid downloading superseded blobs.

The latest source and receipts are recoverable from [checkpoint 478b51b](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/478b51b01fd23774f6ed0c20dcdfd1d53532d8a6/evidence/transport-pr1649-final-memory-and-driver-prep-2026-11-03-2020Z). This also preserves the separate, unadopted driver-look increment: 1,032 native animation phases and all 24 human exports at desktop/phone passed, with canonical owners checked. That follow-up has not been included in this PR or claimed as scene/photographic acceptance.
